page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a dedicated high-frequency cloud instance based on the x86_64 architecture and running under the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, delivering 64 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is configured at 256.0 GB, resulting in an even memory density of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

Network infrastructure on the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance contains no hardware GPU accelerators and is provisioned without local disk storage, relying on external network-attached storage volumes for persistent data retention. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Featuring a elevated 3.1 GHz CPU clock speed and a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio across 64 dedicated cores, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge provides strong multi-threaded compute density. The structural absence of local NVMe storage shifts storage dependencies entirely to network interfaces, presenting a tradeoff for disk-bound environments while serving compute-focused operational requirements such as enterprise application hosting, batch processing, CI/CD pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving.
